entries.rule: Name the bearer: human capacity, a particular inherited language, available stock/system, or an act of speaking. Keep changes of standpoint visible.
entries.exceptions: Do not reduce all language to either a code or an individual utterance. Kawi is a separately dated comparison.

entries.rule: Use study of language(s) for the inquiry in §§1–3 and distinguish its object from the faculty of language.
entries.exceptions: Use linguistics only when its modern disciplinary connotations do not supply an extra historical claim.

entries.rule: Identify what has the pattern. §16 concerns the mental process; later contexts concern construction and the grammar operative in a speaker.
entries.exceptions: Do not default to a taxonomic language class, proto-language or one fixed modern typology. Title: retain general type provisionally, with a note explaining the process bearer.

entries.rule: Keep form visible and state its bearer and relational counterpart. §55 contrasts words with discourse-connection; §136 contrasts thought-form with language-form.
entries.exceptions: Do not equate every Form with shape, morphology, syntax, inner form or a separate metaphysical substance. Later Kawi’s definition is not retroactively imposed.

entries.rule: Structure is the default in §§1–2. Include coordinated relations of parts and their operation, rather than implying an inert anatomical object.
entries.exceptions: Construction may concern sentence organization or a mathematical analogy; it does not name modern Construction Grammar.

entries.rule: Use formation for producing a word/concept/form; development for attained linguistic or national stages; cultivation when exercise and improvement of powers are salient. Preserve evaluative strength.
entries.exceptions: Education is not the universal gloss. Separate ongoing change, attained development and claimed perfection. Bildsamkeit is capacity to be shaped. Einbildungskraft belongs to imagination.

entries.rule: Retain related vocabulary while identifying whether the bearer is a sound, word, language, people or individual speaker. §§29,49,50 successively qualify individuality.
entries.exceptions: No invariant boundary between all three nouns is established. Do not conflate character with inner form or a fixed national essence; commentators emphasize different explanatory roles.

entries.rule: Use mind/mental for thinking agency unless the local spiritual or metaphysical emphasis requires spirit. Preserve the distinct faculty names when the source contrasts them.
entries.exceptions: No fixed modern faculty diagram or Hegelian system is inferred. §126 itself discusses historical changes in these words’ apprehension.

entries.rule: Keep power, capacity and activity distinct. Linguistic powers can be exercised, grow and act on inherited material.
entries.exceptions: Do not default to physical force/energy; do not assert these neighbouring nouns are strict technical synonyms.

entries.rule: Separate the doing, its effect and its manner. Preserve the process/product distinction and the reciprocal influence actually claimed.
entries.exceptions: Wirkung may be operation in context. Do not add activity to a source that names powers alone; later Energeia does not replace every early noun.

entries.rule: Distinguish activity, thought-content and concept where the argument does so. Word and concept are mutually involved, rather than words merely labelling finished concepts.

entries.rule: Choose by local role: representing, sensible/intuitive presentation, or taking an object in a particular way. In §98 the speaker’s apprehension corresponds to the hearer’s designation.
entries.exceptions: Not every Anschauung is visual seeing or an opinion; not every use establishes a fixed Kantian technical sense.

entries.rule: Use view/approach for grammatical ways of organizing relations. In §39 preserve the language-mediated view of the world and individual/historical variation.

entries.rule: Distinguish productive pattern, relative base and proposed historical origin. Sound resemblance alone does not establish descent.

entries.rule: Preserve §136’s distinction of units: thought-relations give Satz unity, while Periode also embodies linguistic organization and intelligible utterance. Retain German on first explanation.
entries.exceptions: The final local choice between proposition and sentence requires the full translated passage. Periode is not merely any long sentence; no one-to-one modern clause/sentence mapping is fixed here.

entries.rule: Keep conceptual thought-relations, a language’s view of them, its technical means and their sounds separate. General grammar covers only part of the general process inquiry.
entries.exceptions: No modern innate universal grammar is imported. Missing inflection is not missing thought or all grammar. Kawi’s language-form extends beyond conventional grammar.

entries.rule: Distinguish what speakers and hearers supply in thought from what audible language indicates. Andeutung can be fixed and strong; the boundary of genuine form is graded in §149.
entries.exceptions: Mental supplementation need not be conscious inference or recovery of an actually deleted word. Genuine form is not simply inflection: §147 allows immutable word order in principle only with a fixed reference point identifiable independently of position. This is the local §147 test, not a universal definition across writings.

entries.rule: Preserve the distinction between content supplied as an object/concept and a relation marked as relation. Check the present function rather than etymological origin alone. For Formalität in §144 preserve the claimed awakening of form as form in the mind, beyond assistance to comprehension.
entries.exceptions: Formalität here does not mean empty ceremony. An originally substantive word may become relational as its prior meaning is lost. Formal character remains a provisional label for that claimed effect; settle its full English expression in the local passage.

entries.limit: Concept/relation contrast supported locally; the best English nominal rendering of Formalität remains open, with its effect specified.
